description: Born-bounded install resource budgets (BI-4F3AB6B3). Single source of truth for compose limits, WSL host ceilings, and the release gate that blocks uncapped always-on services.

postgres.rationale: Primary system of record; bound to leave host headroom under concurrent builds.

portal.rationale: Next.js production runtime; largest always-on app process.

redis.rationale: Durable automation queue store; promoted to the core runtime with a small idle footprint.

inngest.rationale: Durable execution engine; promoted to the core runtime and bounded independently from the portal.

loki.rationale: Log store with 14-day retention; promoted to the core runtime (BI-F8024A9D) because log capture must not be optional. Bounded so a flooding container costs disk and retention, never the host.

alloy.rationale: Log shipper tailing the Docker socket; promoted alongside loki (BI-F8024A9D). Small steady footprint — it forwards rather than stores.

dpf-tts.notes: BI-A0A0568F: keep profile-gated; do not promote to always-on. Idle-process elimination is the preferred long-term path.
